name: Search vllm-project/vllm code, issues, and PRs. Prioritize discovery since 2026-09-01, while retaining older implementation history and research. Trace low-M expert GEMM, static versus shape-aware backend and tile selection, launch costs, CUDA graph capture and replay, and their measured effect on TPOT. Propose at most two falsifiable adaptations, with no invented speedups.
instructions: Investigate DeepSeek on B200 at low concurrency: MoE low-M GEMM and kernel dispatch, static versus shape-aware selection, launch and CUDA graph overhead, and how these affect TPOT. Exclude speculative decoding and MTP. Find code-level mechanisms and negative evidence, not generic performance tips. Keep discovery recent, but do not date-limit prior art. Propose at most two falsifiable adaptations; no invented speedups.
focus: What code-level mechanisms make MoE GEMM and kernel selection affect DeepSeek decode TPOT on B200 at low concurrency, and what evidence challenges the suspected bottlenecks?
constraints: No invented measured bottleneck or speedup
